business.name: White Gold
business.description: Luxury jewelry store specializing in gold jewelry, custom designs, and professional repair services. Prices based on current gold market rates.

services.name: Gold Jewelry Collection
services.description: Wide selection of gold rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. All pieces are hallmarked. Prices based on current gold market rates and design complexity.

services.name: Custom Jewelry Design
services.description: Create your unique piece with our expert jewelers. We work with gold, diamonds, and precious stones.

services.name: Jewelry Repair & Resizing
services.description: Professional repair and restoration services. Ring resizing, chain repair, stone replacement.

services.name: Gold Buying Service
services.description: We buy gold jewelry at competitive market rates. Bring your items for free evaluation.

faqs.question: Do you buy gold jewelry?
faqs.answer: Yes! We buy gold jewelry at current market rates. The price depends on gold weight, purity (585, 750), and current gold market price. Bring your items for free evaluation.

faqs.question: Why do prices change?
faqs.answer: Gold jewelry prices depend on the current market price of gold, which changes daily. We always offer competitive rates based on the latest market data.

faqs.question: Are you open on Monday?
faqs.answer: No, we are closed on Mondays. We work Tuesday-Friday 9:00-18:00, Saturday-Sunday 10:00-17:00.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our jewelry comes with warranty. Terms depend on the type of work - ask our staff for specific details.

faqs.question: Can I trade in my old jewelry?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We accept gold jewelry as trade-in. The value depends on weight, purity, and condition.

faqs.question: How long does custom design take?
faqs.answer: Custom jewelry design typically takes 2-4 weeks depending on complexity. We'll provide exact timeline during consultation.

faqs.question: What purity of gold do you work with?
faqs.answer: We primarily work with 585 (14k) and 750 (18k) gold. We can also source higher purity gold upon request.
